title: Welcome says "Engine: Claude Code" with a check mark, but the value is a default and was never probed
expected: A tick beside the engine means the engine was found on this machine; a Codex-only machine reads Codex or a plain statement of what is missing.
got: The text is settings.engine, which defaults to claude_code and is compared to no probe. The check icon is drawn regardless.
code_check: Traced welcome.engine <- engineLabel(settings.engine); grep shows no probe read in companion/. Not executed in a window.
suggested_acceptance: Welcome reads the daemon probe, or drops the tick and says 'Engine: Claude Code (not yet checked)'.
l2_priority: Fresh store, Codex absent and claude absent (rename the binary): read the welcome text. Precondition: ATHENA_STORE fresh, PATH without claude.

title: "No account, no cloud, no telemetry" and "never asks for a key" overclaim next to a vendor model call and a Connectors vault
expected: Privacy claims scoped to what the product holds: 'Athena stores nothing off this machine; your Claude CLI talks to its provider.'
got: A flat 'No cloud' beside a lock icon. The turn runs on the user's Claude or Codex CLI (a cloud model) and Connectors asks for a Notion token and a Google client secret.
code_check: Read; the engine CLI dialects and connectors are described in README section 3.1 and the Connectors view hints.
suggested_acceptance: Rewording that names the model provider path; the claim about telemetry may stay if a network audit backs it.
l2_priority: Watch outbound connections for the daemon and shell during a turn (no environment beyond a onboarded store and a Claude CLI signed in).

title: Main's status pill reads "Athena is working" in four of her seven states, including docked and resting
expected: 'Athena is resting' whenever she is idle, in whatever form (tab, ledger open, welcome, slip put away).
got: isResting accepts only '', rest, idle, seal. She reports her form name (tab, ledger, welcome, slip) and pillText falls through to 'Athena is working'. Executed over all seven states: seal clean, tape clean, hear clean, slip with a card clean; tab, ledger, welcome and slip without a card say working.
code_check: Function copied into scratchpad pill.mjs and run with node over ATHENA_STATES; output cited in juror--L1.md.
suggested_acceptance: isResting derives from the same table as the companion captions (tab, ledger, welcome count as rest unless working).
l2_priority: Dock her to a screen edge, leave Main open, read the pill. Precondition: onboarded store, Main visible, a drag to a screen edge.

title: "Open your first app" opens no app: it shows Main with an empty address field
expected: The button either opens an app or names the next step ('Choose your first app').
got: setOnboarded(true) -> after_onboarded raises Main on Browser with no tab; the way in is a field with the placeholder invoicing.example.test and a different verb, 'Register and open'.
code_check: Traced control to store write to store.rs:943; no tabs_create on this path.
suggested_acceptance: Label matches the next screen, or the welcome offers a first app to open.
l2_priority: Click 'Open your first app' on a fresh store; confirm Main shows only the register field and no tab. Precondition: ATHENA_STORE fresh, no ATHENA_START_URL.

title: After 'Later (Esc)' Main is hidden and nothing in her surface opens it; only the tray does, and the welcome returns next launch
expected: A visible way to the product after dismissing the welcome.
got: later sets mode auto only; onboarded stays false; the ledger has no Main control and her capability set has no Main command; the tray 'Show Main window' is the one route.
code_check: grep for athenaShow/Main-opening in src/companion: none; Main only opened from tray and after_onboarded.
suggested_acceptance: A control in the ledger or on the seal opens Main; or Later keeps the welcome reachable.
l2_priority: Fresh store, press Esc on the welcome, then try to reach Main without the tray. Precondition: fresh store.

title: Main's close button is labelled "Athena stays" but closing Main exits the whole app
expected: The button does what its accessible label says, or the label says 'Quit Athena'.
got: aria-label 'Close Main window. Athena stays.' while CloseRequested calls handle.exit(0), ending both windows and the daemon.
code_check: Read both sites; the lib.rs comment confirms the quit is deliberate.
suggested_acceptance: Either Main's close hides it and she stays, or the label tells the truth.
l2_priority: Press Main's X with a card waiting and watch both windows. Precondition: onboarded store, Main visible, any waiting card.

title: Three different marks: Main's stamp face, her seal, and a flat-crossbar A in the tray and taskbar
expected: One mark across Main, the companion and the tray (criterion 2).
got: Main and her seal draw the A with a tick crossbar cut from a teal field; the bundled icon (used by tray and Main's taskbar entry) is a cyan A with a flat crossbar on a dark square. athena-mark.png is the flat one and is unused in src. Main's mark and hers are two duplicated SVGs with different field colours.
code_check: Viewed icon.png and athena-mark.png; compared to the SVG paths. grep athena-mark in src returned no import.
suggested_acceptance: Regenerate the icon set from the stamp face; one Mark component shared by both windows.
l2_priority: Screenshot the tray, the taskbar entry, Main's bar and her seal side by side at 100% and 150%. Precondition: a build with a tray and an onboarded store.

title: The decision card does not say which app or origin it would act in
expected: Action, app/origin, recipient, rationale and parameters on the card.
got: CardView has action, rationale, params and nothing about the origin; the header shows only GATED, the tool name and the count. A hands-class action on a page carries no host line.
code_check: Read CardView and the Slip; DecisionRequested fields not fully checked for an origin field.
suggested_acceptance: The slip shows the origin the grant is for (ADR 0026 says grants are per origin).
l2_priority: Raise one real GATED card on ledgerbox and read the slip for an origin line. Precondition: onboarded, ledgerbox on 3001 registered and on, Claude CLI signed in.

title: APPROVED stamp, the spoken 'sent to the record' and the Record row fire before the daemon has answered; a failed resolve leaves no card and no word on the slip
expected: The stamp is the acknowledgement of a recorded answer, or the failure is shown where the card was.
got: decide reduces to the stamp and the screen-reader line 'Approved. Stamped and sent to the record.' immediately; run.answer removes the card first and a failed resolve only sets error (visible on the Talk tab); the Record tab lists 'approved' from the click.
code_check: Read the chain; there is a runtime test on answers but none that rejects api.resolve (not run).
suggested_acceptance: On a rejected resolve the card returns or the slip shows the failure; the 'recorded' wording waits for the reply.
l2_priority: Approve a card with the daemon killed between the card and the click. Precondition: a live card (Claude CLI turn on ledgerbox), then terminate the sidecar.

title: The disabled Speak button explains itself only in a title tooltip
expected: A disabled control says why on screen (criterion 4).
got: disabled with title 'Voice is not available: the daemon has no voice backend'; the note under it silently drops the 'or say approve' sentence.
code_check: Read; Chromium title behaviour on a disabled button not executed.
suggested_acceptance: Visible one-line reason or the button is not drawn when voice is absent.
l2_priority: Hover and tab to the disabled Speak button on a card without a voice backend. Precondition: sidecar launched without voice (default) and a live card.

title: Record tab says 'Every call... Nothing is missing' over a list that is this window's session only
expected: The scope is stated: 'this session; the daemon's model calls are below'.
got: Lead sentence claims completeness; the list is the transcript of the current window, emptied on restart or Clear; the '(showing N of N)' footer is a tautology.
code_check: recordOf reads run.transcript only; clear() resets it (run.ts:405-409).
suggested_acceptance: Lead line scopes the claim; the footer is shown only when something was cut.
l2_priority: Run a turn, press Clear, open Record. Precondition: a completed turn.

title: No path to the decision card in two minutes from a cold start without outside knowledge
expected: From launch to a card in 2 minutes or less (criterion 3), with the product offering the first steps.
got: The product offers no sample app and no sample prompt; the suggestions exclude GATED tools by design, so none leads to a card; the composer is blocked until an origin is focused.
code_check: Counted steps from the welcome to a card by following each control; no timing run.
suggested_acceptance: A sample host and a prompt reach a card in under 90 seconds, or the claim is not made.
l2_priority: Time launch to first card with a stopwatch. Precondition: fresh store, ledgerbox on 3001, Claude CLI signed in.

title: The welcome tier ladder is a static decoration: tier 0 is always the current one and nothing advances
expected: A ladder that shows where she is, or is not drawn as a progress ladder.
got: TIERS is a constant; className cur only for n===0; no store feeds it.
code_check: Read; no reference to tier state in welcome.
suggested_acceptance: Label it as the capability map, or drive it from the probe and connectors.
l2_priority: Read the welcome at 100% and 150% for legibility of the ladder. Precondition: fresh store.

title: Dead wiring around her own hide: hide/show/expand events and athenaHide have no producer; AthenaStatus.visible, activeProjectId and five components are unused
expected: Every declared value reaches a view or a caller (wiring ratio in juror--L1.md).
got: 16 of 19 machine events produced; AthenaStatus 3 of 4 fields used; 10 of 15 components used; athena-mark.png and activeProjectId unused; ui.json grants allow-athena-hide to chrome with no caller. Also run.ts never sends project_id although TurnBody has it.
code_check: grep over src for each name and each importer of components/*.
suggested_acceptance: Remove or wire each; or an ADR line naming them as reserved.
l2_priority: None live; confirm in a build that no hide control is expected. Precondition: onboarded store.

title: Honest edges: every parameter shown uncut, the capture stand-in is labelled 'stylised' and absent live, tools are off until the user enables an origin
got: params are spelled in full (never cut), Sketch is fixture-only and captioned, suggestions skip GATED tools, the Origins tab says tools are off by default, and a truncation is announced.
l2_priority: Confirm a long parameter wraps inside the slip rather than clipping. Precondition: a live card with a long body.
